question: Tamladu is a festival celebrated by the Buddhist community of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamladu** is a festival celebrated by the **Buddhist community **of **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• The festival is celebrated to appease the** local deities and seek their blessings **for a** bountiful harvest.**
 
• Tamladu is celebrated on the **15th day of the Tibetan calendar,** which usually falls in the month of** February or March.**
 
• During the festival, people offer prayers and perform** traditional dances and rituals** to honor their ancestors and seek their blessings.
 
• The festival is an important cultural event for the** Buddhist community of Arunachal Pradesh** and is celebrated with great enthusiasm and fervor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka** is known for its rich cultural heritage and has several festivals celebrated throughout the year.

 
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Karnataka are** Ugadi, Dasara, and Makara Sankranti.**
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh **is known for its vibrant culture and rich history.
 
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Madhya Pradesh are** Diwali, Holi, and Dussehra.**
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is known for its natural beauty and scenic landscapes.
 
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Himachal Pradesh are **Dussehra, Diwali, and Baisakhi.**
